sections.description:
RankFlect SEO – The WordPress SEO Plugin AI Agents Can Run Safely

RankFlect SEO is a complete WordPress SEO plugin with built-in AI SEO tools. Optimize SEO titles and meta descriptions, add schema markup, generate XML sitemaps, connect Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4, manage redirects, run a site audit, and get your content ready for AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews.

It is also built so AI agents can work on your SEO safely. The built-in MCP server connects Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code or any MCP client to 101 SEO tools (128 with Pro). You choose what an agent can touch, approve its edits, and undo any change.

Free for unlimited sites – no account and no credits to buy.

Website | Documentation

Why Choose RankFlect SEO?

  • ✔ Safe AI agents built in – 101 SEO tools over MCP, running inside WordPress with no Node.js or companion plugin. Scoped tokens, dry-run, approval by default and a full undo log.
  • ✔ Connect claude.ai and ChatGPT for free – sign in through a WordPress consent screen with read-only, content editor or full access.
  • ✔ Bring your own AI key – Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio or vLLM. No credits, no lock-in.
  • ✔ Lightweight and fast – modules load only when enabled, and front-end CSS only where blocks are used.
  • ✔ Works with every editor – Gutenberg, Classic Editor and Elementor, plus Divi, Oxygen, Breakdance and Bricks.
  • ✔ Multilingual SEO – WPML, Polylang and TranslatePress with hreflang and language-aware sitemaps.
  • ✔ One-click migration from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress and 3 more, with undo.

AI SEO Content Writer: Optimize Content with Your Own AI

  • AI SEO title and meta description generator with focus keyword suggestions.
  • AI image alt text generator, with vision support when your model has it.
  • AI content briefs and full article drafts, saved as drafts for you to review.
  • “Explain with AI” on every SEO recommendation.
  • Daily AI request limit, a “Pause all AI” switch, and “Hide AI features” to remove every AI button and stop all AI requests.

Built-in MCP Server for AI Agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor)

Manage WordPress SEO by chatting with an AI assistant – safely.

  • 101 SEO tools in the free plugin, 128 with Pro.
  • claude.ai and ChatGPT connect by URL; Cursor, VS Code and Claude Code connect with a token.
  • Scoped, revocable tokens per area (none, read or write) – not a full-access Application Password.
  • Change Log with approve, reject or undo. Site-wide agent changes always need an administrator.
  • Ready-made MCP prompts, setup guides and WordPress Abilities API support (WordPress 6.9+).

On-Page WordPress SEO, Meta Tags and Content Analysis

  • SEO titles, meta descriptions, robots meta, canonical URLs, Open Graph and X (Twitter) Cards, with templates and variables like %title% and %sitename%.
  • Real-time content analysis with focus keyword and readability scores, and a keyword cannibalization warning.
  • Headline analyzer with a live 0–100 score.
  • AI answer readiness score – how easily AI answers can understand and quote each post.
  • Google SERP preview plus Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn and Pinterest social previews.
  • Bulk SEO editor for titles, descriptions and focus keywords, plus a duplicate title and meta description report.
  • Quick Edit and undoable bulk actions in post lists, an SEO score column and a Links column that flags orphaned posts.
  • Primary category for breadcrumbs and permalinks.
  • Category and tag (taxonomy) SEO – titles, descriptions and robots for every term.
  • Pixel-width bars showing where Google cuts titles and descriptions, and an admin bar SEO score.
  • External link rules – nofollow, sponsored, ugc and new-tab, with allow and deny lists, plus per-link sponsored and UGC switches.
  • Hide any block from search and AI snippets (data-nosnippet), plus a [rankflect_nosnippet] shortcode.

Schema Markup (Structured Data / Rich Snippets)

Win rich snippets in Google with automatic structured data – no code needed.

  • Automatic JSON-LD schema graph: Organization or Person, LocalBusiness, WebSite, WebPage, Article, Product, BreadcrumbList and FAQPage.
  • Schema manager with 16 schema types on every post: Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, FAQPage, HowTo, VideoObject, Review, Recipe, Event, Course, SoftwareApplication, Product, Person, Service, JobPosting or custom JSON-LD.
  • Schema validator that shows the final graph, errors and recommendations, linked to Google’s Rich Results Test.
  • Import schema from any URL and map it to your post.
  • FAQ, How-to and Table of Contents blocks (and Elementor widgets) with schema and no front-end JavaScript.

XML Sitemap, Indexing and robots.txt

  • XML sitemaps built on WordPress core sitemaps, with image sitemaps, noindexed content excluded, translations linked and a readable view in the browser.
  • HTML sitemap block and shortcode.
  • robots.txt and .htaccess editor that restores the previous file automatically if your home page breaks.
  • RSS feed controls.
  • IndexNow instant indexing for Bing and Yandex.
  • One-click switches for AI crawlers: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and more.
  • Content Signals in robots.txt – allow AI search and answers, opt out of AI training.
  • llms.txt generator (per language on Polylang sites).
  • AI crawler analytics – which AI bots read which pages over the last 90 days.

Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4

  • Google Search Console inside WordPress: clicks, impressions, CTR, position, top queries and pages.
  • Google Analytics 4: traffic, engagement and visits from AI assistants.
  • Connect with your own Google OAuth client or a service account (ideal for agencies), read-only.
  • Already use Site Kit by Google? Reuse its connection for Search Console and GA4.
  • Optional GA4 tag installer, dashboard widget and monthly SEO email report.

SEO Site Audit, Page Speed and Security

  • SEO site audit with a 0–100 score and one-click fixes, run automatically every 7 days with no crawl load.
  • PageSpeed Insights and Core Web Vitals for any URL, with history.
  • Competitor analysis – compare a competitor’s page with yours side by side.
  • Optional hardening: XML-RPC, user enumeration, file editor and WordPress version.
  • Crawl cleanup – remove feed, shortlink, RSD, oEmbed and REST API links and emoji scripts from the page head.

Redirect Manager (301 Redirects)

  • 301, 302 and 307 redirects with hit counts.
  • Automatic redirects when a slug changes, and a prompt when you delete published content.
  • Redirect CSV import and export with a preview before importing.
  • Import redirects from Redirection, Rank Math, Yoast Premium, AIOSEO, SEOPress and Squirrly.

Image SEO

  • Automatic image alt text, titles and captions from file names on upload.
  • Media Library bulk action and one-click fill for images missing alt text.

Local SEO

  • Business details, opening hours (split hours, 24-hour days, closed days) and LocalBusiness schema.
  • [rankflect_local] shortcode, Business Info block and a locations.kml sitemap.

WooCommerce SEO

  • Full Product schema with price, availability, GTIN, brand, images, ratings and reviews.
  • Product variables for SEO titles.
  • Cart, checkout and account pages kept out of search automatically.

Site Management

  • Setup wizard, a self-ticking SEO checklist and an SEO plugin conflict warning with one-click deactivation.
  • Notification center for indexing, Google sign-in and audit problems.
  • Role manager for every SEO area and agent approvals.
  • Backups before every import and bulk change, with one-click restore.
  • SEO data CSV export and import: edit titles, descriptions and focus keywords in a spreadsheet, with a preview and one-click undo.
  • Breadcrumbs block, shortcode and template tag, with BreadcrumbList schema.
  • Site verification for Google, Bing, Yandex, Pinterest and Baidu.
  • Code and tracking: Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity and custom head and footer code.
  • Settings search with / or Ctrl+K.

Built for Developers

  • REST API for SEO data, including headless setups.
  • Hooks and filters to change any output.
  • Shortcodes and template tags for breadcrumbs, local business info and HTML sitemaps.
  • wp-config constants for locked-down or managed hosting.
  • 111 documentation guides at rankflectseo.com/docs.

Switch from Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO or SEOPress in One Click

Looking for a Yoast SEO alternative or Rank Math alternative? Bring over your post and term SEO, redirects and title templates in one click, with a backup first and full undo.

RankFlect SEO Pro

The free plugin is complete on its own. RankFlect SEO Pro is an optional upgrade with a 14-day free trial (no card needed) and a 14-day money-back guarantee.

Pro pricing: Personal $59/year (1 site) · Plus $99/year (5 sites) · Agency $199/year (unlimited sites) · Lifetime Agency $299 one-time. Licenses can be moved between sites.

Pro adds:

  • AI visibility tracking – whether AI assistants mention and cite you, via your own AI key with web search, with share of voice.
  • AI prompt gap finder – questions where AI names competitors but not you, with one-click AI Writer briefs.
  • Unlimited focus keywords, keyword synonyms and word forms.
  • Rank tracker, AI insights, Traffic Recovery and Focus Pages.
  • Search Console opportunities, URL inspection and index status for every post.
  • AI internal linking suggestions, AI metadata on publish, bulk AI and AI FAQ generator.
  • SEO Autopilot – scheduled jobs fix meta descriptions, alt text, internal links and audit issues, all waiting for your approval.
  • Schema templates with display conditions and custom fields (ACF, Meta Box, Pods).
  • News and Video sitemaps, Markdown versions of pages, llms-full.txt and an AI usage policy.
  • Multiple locations, advanced WooCommerce SEO (GTIN, MPN, ISBN, variation offers) and AI referral revenue.
  • Regex redirects, 308/410/451, 404 monitor and broken link checker.
  • On-demand site audits, audit history and branded email reports.
  • Slack and webhook alerts for audit drops, 404 spikes and broken links.
  • WP-CLI commands for agencies and hosts.

Start your 14-day free trial

Source Code

Admin screens are built with React and @wordpress/scripts. Uncompiled source is in the plugin’s src folder. Run npm install && npm run build:free to rebuild.

External services

RankFlect SEO has no server of its own and sends nothing on activation. It contacts the services below only when you set up or use the feature that needs them.

Google OAuth, Search Console and Google Analytics APIs – used after you connect Google in RankFlect SEO → Analytics. Your browser opens accounts.google.com with your OAuth client ID and read-only scopes. Your site exchanges the code, client ID and secret with oauth2.googleapis.com (or sends a signed service-account request). Reports call www.googleapis.com/webmasters/v3, analyticsadmin.googleapis.com and analyticsdata.googleapis.com with your property and date range (and, in the editor, the page URL). On disconnect the refresh token is sent to oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke. Google Terms, Google APIs Terms, Privacy Policy.

Google Analytics (gtag.js) – only if you enter a GA4 Measurement ID. Visitors’ browsers load www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js, which sends page views and browser data to Google Analytics. Logged-in editors are not tracked by default. Google Analytics Terms, Privacy Policy.

Google Tag Manager – only if you enter a container ID in Settings → Code and tracking. Visitors’ browsers load www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js (or ns.html without JavaScript), which runs the tags in your container. Tag Manager Use Policy, Privacy Policy.

Microsoft Clarity – only if you enter a Clarity project ID. Visitors’ browsers load www.clarity.ms/tag, which sends page views, clicks, scrolling and browser data to Microsoft. Clarity Terms, Microsoft Privacy Statement.

AI providers – only after you add your own API key in RankFlect SEO → Settings → AI, and only when you or an authorized agent starts an AI action. Requests send your API key and the text the task needs: the post title, up to 6,000 characters of post text, the focus keyword, site name and tone. Content briefs and drafts send the topic, keyword and related post titles. Competitor comparisons send both pages’ URLs, titles, descriptions, headings, word counts, schema types and up to 1,500 characters of text. Alt text sends the image, its file name and the parent page title. Only the selected provider is contacted:

  • Anthropic (api.anthropic.com): Commercial Terms, Privacy Policy
  • OpenAI (api.openai.com): Terms of Use, Privacy Policy
  • Google Gemini (generativelanguage.googleapis.com): Gemini API Terms, Privacy Policy
  • OpenRouter (openrouter.ai), which also receives your site URL as referrer: Terms, Privacy Policy
  • OpenAI-compatible server: requests go to the base URL you enter (for example local Ollama or LM Studio), under that server’s terms.
  • WordPress AI connector (WordPress 7.0+): requests go to the provider configured in Settings → Connectors, under that provider’s terms.

IndexNow – only when the IndexNow module is on (off by default). On publish/update or manual submit, your site sends api.indexnow.org your host name, IndexNow key, key file URL and changed URLs, which are shared with participating search engines such as Bing and Yandex. Nothing is sent from local or development environments. IndexNow terms, Microsoft Privacy Statement.

Google PageSpeed Insights – only when you or an authorized agent run a speed test, or weekly for your home page if enabled (off by default). Sends www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed the URL, device and optional API key. Google Terms, Google APIs Terms, Privacy Policy.

Pages you ask RankFlect SEO to read – competitor analysis and “Import schema from URL” make one GET request to the address you enter (and your own page for comparisons), with a user agent naming RankFlect SEO and your site URL. The site audit also requests a few of your own pages to check security and performance.

Slack and webhooks (Pro) – only if you add a Slack (hooks.slack.com) or other https webhook URL. On a chosen event (once a day at most) or a test, it posts the site name and URL, event, a short message and a wp-admin link. Slack Terms, Privacy Policy.

Freemius – used for the optional opt-in, Pro upgrade and trials. Nothing is sent unless you opt in, start a trial or buy Pro. If you opt in, Freemius receives your site URL, WordPress and PHP versions, plugin version, name, email and plugin events (activation, deactivation, uninstall, optional feedback). You can opt out any time. Freemius Terms, Freemius Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for RankFlect SEO, click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Follow the setup wizard, or import your settings from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO or SEOPress.
  4. Optional: add your AI provider key in RankFlect SEO → Settings → AI.
  5. Optional: connect Google Search Console and GA4 in RankFlect SEO → Analytics.
  6. Optional: connect Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor in RankFlect SEO → AI Agents.
sections.faq:
What is RankFlect SEO?

RankFlect SEO is a free AI SEO plugin and complete WordPress SEO toolkit. It handles meta titles and descriptions, content analysis, schema markup, XML sitemaps, Google Search Console, redirects, site audits and llms.txt, and includes a built-in MCP server so AI agents can manage your SEO safely.

Is RankFlect SEO a good Yoast SEO or Rank Math alternative?

Yes. It covers the core features of Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO and SEOPress, and adds safe AI agent access, bring-your-own AI key with no credits, an AI answer readiness score and AI crawler analytics. Redirects are free (Yoast puts them in Premium), the MCP server needs no Node.js setup, and Pro starts at $59/year with no AI credits to buy. You can import your existing SEO data in one click.

How much does RankFlect SEO Pro cost?

The free plugin works on unlimited sites. Pro costs $59/year for 1 site, $99/year for 5 sites, $199/year for unlimited sites, or $299 once for a lifetime Agency license. Every plan has a 14-day free trial and a 14-day money-back guarantee.

Can I switch from Yoast SEO or Rank Math without losing my SEO?

Yes. The importer copies post and term SEO, redirects and title templates from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, Slim SEO and Squirrly SEO. A backup is made first and the import can be undone.

Is the free version limited?

No. The free plugin is a complete SEO plugin with AI tools, schema, sitemaps, Search Console, GA4, redirects, site audit, local SEO and WooCommerce SEO. Pro adds advanced features like AI visibility tracking, rank tracking, SEO Autopilot and a 404 monitor.

Do I need to pay for AI?

No credits are needed. Add your own API key from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or OpenRouter, or use a free local model through Ollama, LM Studio or vLLM. You only pay your AI provider, if anything.

What is the RankFlect SEO MCP server?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI assistants use tools. RankFlect SEO’s built-in MCP server gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code and other MCP clients access to 101 SEO tools on your site (128 with Pro), within the permissions you choose. It runs inside WordPress, with no Node.js or companion plugin.

Can an AI agent break my site?

Agent access is off by default. Tokens are scoped per area (none, read or write), and claude.ai or ChatGPT sign-ins get read-only, content editor or full access. An agent can never install, activate or update plugins or themes, manage users, change WordPress settings, restore backups or edit files, even with an administrator’s token. Every write can be dry-run first, edits wait for your approval by default, and every change is logged in the Change Log where you can undo it.

Which AI clients can connect?

claude.ai and ChatGPT connect by URL. Cursor, VS Code and Claude Code connect with a token. Any other MCP-compatible client works too.

Does RankFlect SEO send my content anywhere?

Not by default. RankFlect SEO has no server of its own. Content is sent only to the AI provider you configure, and only when you or an authorized agent runs an AI action. See External Services above.

Does RankFlect SEO help with AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)?

Yes. It includes an AI answer readiness score, llms.txt generator, AI crawler controls in robots.txt, AI crawler analytics and GA4 reports for visits from AI assistants. Pro adds AI visibility tracking.

Does llms.txt improve Google rankings?

No. llms.txt is an index of your key pages for AI tools and agents. It does not affect Google rankings or guarantee AI citations.

Will RankFlect SEO slow down my site?

No. Modules only run when switched on, there are no admin nags, and front-end CSS loads only on pages using RankFlect SEO blocks. FAQ, How-to and Table of Contents blocks use no front-end JavaScript.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi and other page builders?

Yes. Gutenberg, the Classic Editor and Elementor get a native SEO panel. Content analysis also reads Divi, Oxygen, Breakdance and Bricks pages.

Does it work on multilingual sites?

Yes. WPML, Polylang and TranslatePress are supported with hreflang, og:locale alternates and language-aware sitemaps.

Does RankFlect SEO support WooCommerce SEO?

Yes. It adds full Product schema (price, availability, GTIN, brand, images, ratings, reviews), product title variables and keeps cart, checkout and account pages out of search.

Why do I create my own Google Cloud client?

So your Search Console and Analytics data goes straight from Google to your site with read-only access, with no third-party server in between.

What happens when I uninstall RankFlect SEO?

Deactivating keeps all data and simply pauses the plugin (redirects stop, so move them first if you are switching). Deleting the plugin removes its settings, redirects, logs, Change Log, backups and cached reports. Your per-post and per-term SEO fields and image alt text are kept on purpose, so reinstalling brings them back. You can export everything as JSON first from RankFlect SEO → Tools → Export & import.

Does RankFlect SEO have readability analysis?

Yes. Alongside the SEO score, a separate readability score checks reading ease, sentence and paragraph length, passive voice and transition words.

Does RankFlect SEO have a REST API and developer hooks?

Yes. It includes a REST API, hooks and filters, shortcodes, template tags, wp-config constants and a full MCP tool reference. WP-CLI commands are available with Pro.

What are the requirements?

WordPress 6.6 or newer and PHP 7.4 or newer. Pretty permalinks are needed for llms.txt and Markdown pages. Connecting claude.ai or ChatGPT by URL needs a public HTTPS site; local sites can use Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor or VS Code instead.

The full history with screenshots is also at rankflectseo.com/changelog.

1.3.8 – November 9, 2026

  • New: Crawl cleanup. Remove feed, shortlink, RSD, oEmbed and REST API links and the emoji scripts from the page head, each with its own switch. Feeds and the REST API keep working.

description:
RankFlect SEO – The WordPress SEO Plugin AI Agents Can Run Safely

RankFlect SEO is a complete WordPress SEO plugin with built-in AI SEO tools. Optimize SEO titles and meta descriptions, add schema markup, generate XML sitemaps, connect Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4, manage redirects, run a site audit, and get your content ready for AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews.

It is also built so AI agents can work on your SEO safely. The built-in MCP server connects Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code or any MCP client to 101 SEO tools (128 with Pro). You choose what an agent can touch, approve its edits, and undo any change.

Free for unlimited sites – no account and no credits to buy.

Website | Documentation

Why Choose RankFlect SEO?

  • ✔ Safe AI agents built in – 101 SEO tools over MCP, running inside WordPress with no Node.js or companion plugin. Scoped tokens, dry-run, approval by default and a full undo log.
  • ✔ Connect claude.ai and ChatGPT for free – sign in through a WordPress consent screen with read-only, content editor or full access.
  • ✔ Bring your own AI key – Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio or vLLM. No credits, no lock-in.
  • ✔ Lightweight and fast – modules load only when enabled, and front-end CSS only where blocks are used.
  • ✔ Works with every editor – Gutenberg, Classic Editor and Elementor, plus Divi, Oxygen, Breakdance and Bricks.
  • ✔ Multilingual SEO – WPML, Polylang and TranslatePress with hreflang and language-aware sitemaps.
  • ✔ One-click migration from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress and 3 more, with undo.

AI SEO Content Writer: Optimize Content with Your Own AI

  • AI SEO title and meta description generator with focus keyword suggestions.
  • AI image alt text generator, with vision support when your model has it.
  • AI content briefs and full article drafts, saved as drafts for you to review.
  • “Explain with AI” on every SEO recommendation.
  • Daily AI request limit, a “Pause all AI” switch, and “Hide AI features” to remove every AI button and stop all AI requests.

Built-in MCP Server for AI Agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor)

Manage WordPress SEO by chatting with an AI assistant – safely.

  • 101 SEO tools in the free plugin, 128 with Pro.
  • claude.ai and ChatGPT connect by URL; Cursor, VS Code and Claude Code connect with a token.
  • Scoped, revocable tokens per area (none, read or write) – not a full-access Application Password.
  • Change Log with approve, reject or undo. Site-wide agent changes always need an administrator.
  • Ready-made MCP prompts, setup guides and WordPress Abilities API support (WordPress 6.9+).

On-Page WordPress SEO, Meta Tags and Content Analysis

  • SEO titles, meta descriptions, robots meta, canonical URLs, Open Graph and X (Twitter) Cards, with templates and variables like %title% and %sitename%.
  • Real-time content analysis with focus keyword and readability scores, and a keyword cannibalization warning.
  • Headline analyzer with a live 0–100 score.
  • AI answer readiness score – how easily AI answers can understand and quote each post.
  • Google SERP preview plus Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn and Pinterest social previews.
  • Bulk SEO editor for titles, descriptions and focus keywords, plus a duplicate title and meta description report.
  • Quick Edit and undoable bulk actions in post lists, an SEO score column and a Links column that flags orphaned posts.
  • Primary category for breadcrumbs and permalinks.
  • Category and tag (taxonomy) SEO – titles, descriptions and robots for every term.
  • Pixel-width bars showing where Google cuts titles and descriptions, and an admin bar SEO score.
  • External link rules – nofollow, sponsored, ugc and new-tab, with allow and deny lists, plus per-link sponsored and UGC switches.
  • Hide any block from search and AI snippets (data-nosnippet), plus a [rankflect_nosnippet] shortcode.

Schema Markup (Structured Data / Rich Snippets)

Win rich snippets in Google with automatic structured data – no code needed.

  • Automatic JSON-LD schema graph: Organization or Person, LocalBusiness, WebSite, WebPage, Article, Product, BreadcrumbList and FAQPage.
  • Schema manager with 16 schema types on every post: Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, FAQPage, HowTo, VideoObject, Review, Recipe, Event, Course, SoftwareApplication, Product, Person, Service, JobPosting or custom JSON-LD.
  • Schema validator that shows the final graph, errors and recommendations, linked to Google’s Rich Results Test.
  • Import schema from any URL and map it to your post.
  • FAQ, How-to and Table of Contents blocks (and Elementor widgets) with schema and no front-end JavaScript.

XML Sitemap, Indexing and robots.txt

  • XML sitemaps built on WordPress core sitemaps, with image sitemaps, noindexed content excluded, translations linked and a readable view in the browser.
  • HTML sitemap block and shortcode.
  • robots.txt and .htaccess editor that restores the previous file automatically if your home page breaks.
  • RSS feed controls.
  • IndexNow instant indexing for Bing and Yandex.
  • One-click switches for AI crawlers: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and more.
  • Content Signals in robots.txt – allow AI search and answers, opt out of AI training.
  • llms.txt generator (per language on Polylang sites).
  • AI crawler analytics – which AI bots read which pages over the last 90 days.

Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4

  • Google Search Console inside WordPress: clicks, impressions, CTR, position, top queries and pages.
  • Google Analytics 4: traffic, engagement and visits from AI assistants.
  • Connect with your own Google OAuth client or a service account (ideal for agencies), read-only.
  • Already use Site Kit by Google? Reuse its connection for Search Console and GA4.
  • Optional GA4 tag installer, dashboard widget and monthly SEO email report.

SEO Site Audit, Page Speed and Security

  • SEO site audit with a 0–100 score and one-click fixes, run automatically every 7 days with no crawl load.
  • PageSpeed Insights and Core Web Vitals for any URL, with history.
  • Competitor analysis – compare a competitor’s page with yours side by side.
  • Optional hardening: XML-RPC, user enumeration, file editor and WordPress version.
  • Crawl cleanup – remove feed, shortlink, RSD, oEmbed and REST API links and emoji scripts from the page head.

Redirect Manager (301 Redirects)

  • 301, 302 and 307 redirects with hit counts.
  • Automatic redirects when a slug changes, and a prompt when you delete published content.
  • Redirect CSV import and export with a preview before importing.
  • Import redirects from Redirection, Rank Math, Yoast Premium, AIOSEO, SEOPress and Squirrly.

Image SEO

  • Automatic image alt text, titles and captions from file names on upload.
  • Media Library bulk action and one-click fill for images missing alt text.

Local SEO

  • Business details, opening hours (split hours, 24-hour days, closed days) and LocalBusiness schema.
  • [rankflect_local] shortcode, Business Info block and a locations.kml sitemap.

WooCommerce SEO

  • Full Product schema with price, availability, GTIN, brand, images, ratings and reviews.
  • Product variables for SEO titles.
  • Cart, checkout and account pages kept out of search automatically.

Site Management

  • Setup wizard, a self-ticking SEO checklist and an SEO plugin conflict warning with one-click deactivation.
  • Notification center for indexing, Google sign-in and audit problems.
  • Role manager for every SEO area and agent approvals.
  • Backups before every import and bulk change, with one-click restore.
  • SEO data CSV export and import: edit titles, descriptions and focus keywords in a spreadsheet, with a preview and one-click undo.
  • Breadcrumbs block, shortcode and template tag, with BreadcrumbList schema.
  • Site verification for Google, Bing, Yandex, Pinterest and Baidu.
  • Code and tracking: Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity and custom head and footer code.
  • Settings search with / or Ctrl+K.

Built for Developers

  • REST API for SEO data, including headless setups.
  • Hooks and filters to change any output.
  • Shortcodes and template tags for breadcrumbs, local business info and HTML sitemaps.
  • wp-config constants for locked-down or managed hosting.
  • 111 documentation guides at rankflectseo.com/docs.

Switch from Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO or SEOPress in One Click

Looking for a Yoast SEO alternative or Rank Math alternative? Bring over your post and term SEO, redirects and title templates in one click, with a backup first and full undo.

RankFlect SEO Pro

The free plugin is complete on its own. RankFlect SEO Pro is an optional upgrade with a 14-day free trial (no card needed) and a 14-day money-back guarantee.

Pro pricing: Personal $59/year (1 site) · Plus $99/year (5 sites) · Agency $199/year (unlimited sites) · Lifetime Agency $299 one-time. Licenses can be moved between sites.

Pro adds:

  • AI visibility tracking – whether AI assistants mention and cite you, via your own AI key with web search, with share of voice.
  • AI prompt gap finder – questions where AI names competitors but not you, with one-click AI Writer briefs.
  • Unlimited focus keywords, keyword synonyms and word forms.
  • Rank tracker, AI insights, Traffic Recovery and Focus Pages.
  • Search Console opportunities, URL inspection and index status for every post.
  • AI internal linking suggestions, AI metadata on publish, bulk AI and AI FAQ generator.
  • SEO Autopilot – scheduled jobs fix meta descriptions, alt text, internal links and audit issues, all waiting for your approval.
  • Schema templates with display conditions and custom fields (ACF, Meta Box, Pods).
  • News and Video sitemaps, Markdown versions of pages, llms-full.txt and an AI usage policy.
  • Multiple locations, advanced WooCommerce SEO (GTIN, MPN, ISBN, variation offers) and AI referral revenue.
  • Regex redirects, 308/410/451, 404 monitor and broken link checker.
  • On-demand site audits, audit history and branded email reports.
  • Slack and webhook alerts for audit drops, 404 spikes and broken links.
  • WP-CLI commands for agencies and hosts.

Start your 14-day free trial

Source Code

Admin screens are built with React and @wordpress/scripts. Uncompiled source is in the plugin’s src folder. Run npm install && npm run build:free to rebuild.

External services

RankFlect SEO has no server of its own and sends nothing on activation. It contacts the services below only when you set up or use the feature that needs them.

Google OAuth, Search Console and Google Analytics APIs – used after you connect Google in RankFlect SEO → Analytics. Your browser opens accounts.google.com with your OAuth client ID and read-only scopes. Your site exchanges the code, client ID and secret with oauth2.googleapis.com (or sends a signed service-account request). Reports call www.googleapis.com/webmasters/v3, analyticsadmin.googleapis.com and analyticsdata.googleapis.com with your property and date range (and, in the editor, the page URL). On disconnect the refresh token is sent to oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke. Google Terms, Google APIs Terms, Privacy Policy.

Google Analytics (gtag.js) – only if you enter a GA4 Measurement ID. Visitors’ browsers load www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js, which sends page views and browser data to Google Analytics. Logged-in editors are not tracked by default. Google Analytics Terms, Privacy Policy.

Google Tag Manager – only if you enter a container ID in Settings → Code and tracking. Visitors’ browsers load www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js (or ns.html without JavaScript), which runs the tags in your container. Tag Manager Use Policy, Privacy Policy.

Microsoft Clarity – only if you enter a Clarity project ID. Visitors’ browsers load www.clarity.ms/tag, which sends page views, clicks, scrolling and browser data to Microsoft. Clarity Terms, Microsoft Privacy Statement.

AI providers – only after you add your own API key in RankFlect SEO → Settings → AI, and only when you or an authorized agent starts an AI action. Requests send your API key and the text the task needs: the post title, up to 6,000 characters of post text, the focus keyword, site name and tone. Content briefs and drafts send the topic, keyword and related post titles. Competitor comparisons send both pages’ URLs, titles, descriptions, headings, word counts, schema types and up to 1,500 characters of text. Alt text sends the image, its file name and the parent page title. Only the selected provider is contacted:

  • Anthropic (api.anthropic.com): Commercial Terms, Privacy Policy
  • OpenAI (api.openai.com): Terms of Use, Privacy Policy
  • Google Gemini (generativelanguage.googleapis.com): Gemini API Terms, Privacy Policy
  • OpenRouter (openrouter.ai), which also receives your site URL as referrer: Terms, Privacy Policy
  • OpenAI-compatible server: requests go to the base URL you enter (for example local Ollama or LM Studio), under that server’s terms.
  • WordPress AI connector (WordPress 7.0+): requests go to the provider configured in Settings → Connectors, under that provider’s terms.

IndexNow – only when the IndexNow module is on (off by default). On publish/update or manual submit, your site sends api.indexnow.org your host name, IndexNow key, key file URL and changed URLs, which are shared with participating search engines such as Bing and Yandex. Nothing is sent from local or development environments. IndexNow terms, Microsoft Privacy Statement.

Google PageSpeed Insights – only when you or an authorized agent run a speed test, or weekly for your home page if enabled (off by default). Sends www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed the URL, device and optional API key. Google Terms, Google APIs Terms, Privacy Policy.

Pages you ask RankFlect SEO to read – competitor analysis and “Import schema from URL” make one GET request to the address you enter (and your own page for comparisons), with a user agent naming RankFlect SEO and your site URL. The site audit also requests a few of your own pages to check security and performance.

Slack and webhooks (Pro) – only if you add a Slack (hooks.slack.com) or other https webhook URL. On a chosen event (once a day at most) or a test, it posts the site name and URL, event, a short message and a wp-admin link. Slack Terms, Privacy Policy.

Freemius – used for the optional opt-in, Pro upgrade and trials. Nothing is sent unless you opt in, start a trial or buy Pro. If you opt in, Freemius receives your site URL, WordPress and PHP versions, plugin version, name, email and plugin events (activation, deactivation, uninstall, optional feedback). You can opt out any time. Freemius Terms, Freemius Privacy Policy.
